correctness.rationale: Lucas gives F(n)=2^{s_2(n)}; exact carry enumeration gives integer transfer matrices T0 and T1 and exact cyclic cross-sums. Binomial digit products give means 3^L/2^L and second moments 5^L/2^L, hence Pearson normalization. The T0 tail converges exactly to (1,2/3), while T1v <= 5v with strict first component proves sharp upper bound with equality only Hamming weight one; positivity follows from positive carry-zero path. The alternating transfer matrix has characteristic polynomial t^2-24t+100, giving the claimed recurrence and decay. 5,592,404 direct finite terms verified; finite tests are consistency checks, not proof.

value.rationale: A complete exact dependence profile for the natural arithmetic statistic counting nonzero entries of binary Pascal rows. The all-shift rational formula and strict global upper bound with complete equality cases, plus exact unattained zero infimum with spectral rate, are nontrivial structural facts that are neither one-off substitutions nor narrow unmotivated numerical slices; they reveal carry-sensitive dependence hidden by the classical marginal count.
